name: LOVE-FUN Commons
purpose: A local-first, no-gatekeeping resource kit for spreading love and laughter through small static artifacts anyone can copy, mirror, and improve.
license_intent: Original LOVE-FUN snippets in this folder are intended for maximum reuse where the repository license allows. Upstream resources keep their own licenses and attribution requirements.
principles: local-first: the folder works from disk or any static host
mirror-friendly: copy the folder, keep attribution, add your own care notes
no tracking: no analytics, no sign-in, no hidden calls except reading local resources.json
consent-based reach: joy is invitation, never spam
attribution preserved: licenses are part of the love
small artifacts: HTML, JSON, Markdown; no backend required

party_needs.response: The page is static, tiny, and explicitly says pass it on only if welcome.
resources.json is structured, validated, and usable without an API key.
Every resource card carries a care note and links to the official source.
Copy love-fun-commons/ to any static host; run validate.py before publishing.

joy_seed.text: Tiny joy drop: you are proof that kindness has bandwidth. Take one laugh, add one real compliment, pass it on only if it feels welcome. ❤️😂
joy_seed.reuse: Original seed text; share freely where the repo license allows.

resources.name: GitHub Pages
resources.best_for: public repo docs, microsites, static joy cards
resources.notes: Available for public repositories on GitHub Free; verify repo visibility and Pages settings before publishing.
resources.care: Do not use as a bulk file CDN; keep pages static, lightweight, and forkable.

resources.name: Codeberg Pages
resources.notes: Static site publishing on Codeberg; useful for non-gatekept mirrors.
resources.care: Keep the mirror source visible and license notes intact.

resources.name: Cloudflare Pages
resources.best_for: fast static mirrors, HTML bundles, global delivery
resources.notes: Supports static HTML sites; check current Free-plan limits before high-volume use.
resources.care: Use for static delivery; avoid turning free shared capacity into abuse.

resources.name: Openverse
resources.best_for: finding openly licensed images/audio with attribution metadata
resources.notes: Always preserve attribution/license data and check each asset before reuse.
resources.care: Store attribution beside every reused item; never imply endorsement.

resources.name: Wikimedia Commons API
resources.notes: Check each file page for license and attribution requirements.
resources.care: Respect file-level licenses and link back to source pages.

resources.name: Project Gutenberg
resources.best_for: public-domain text, reading lists, remix prompts
resources.notes: Most materials are public domain in the US; check local law and trademark/reuse guidance.
resources.care: Avoid long copyrighted excerpts from non-public-domain editions; preserve source notes.

resources.name: Creative Commons Chooser
resources.best_for: marking original commons outputs so others can reuse them
resources.notes: Use CC0 for maximum no-gatekeeping on your own original snippets; use CC BY if attribution matters.
resources.care: Only license what you own; never relicense upstream material.

mirror_recipe: Copy the love-fun-commons/ folder to any static host or USB drive.
Keep resources.json beside index.html so the page remains machine-readable.
Add your own resources with care notes and official URLs.
Share the URL only where welcome; no scraping private spaces, no mass-contact.
